ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity regions occupying the lateral quadrants of both lobes; dark low-intensity pigmentation dominates the central peduncle area and trailing edge margins, featuring fine-grained mottling on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel-based internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations characterized by multiple peaks and valleys (3-15 pixel amplitude) distributed along the trailing edge, with significant jaggedness on the inner right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge sweeping from the distal tips toward the median notch, with convex leading edge curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) located at the primary distal tips of both lobes; one isolated circular mark on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) detected in the dark-pigmented region of the right lobe near the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at distal extremities; multiple localized circular scars and pitting across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Active water turbulence and spray occluding the lower central insertion point of the fluke into the peduncle.
